europe_now.title: Cyberattacks on Regional Industrial Systems
europe_now.summary: Recent cyber incidents targeting supermarket refrigeration units have highlighted vulnerabilities in connected industrial infrastructure across Europe. Officials and cybersecurity experts have warned that such breaches pose significant risks to the bloc's food supply and public trust.

sources.headline: Refrigeration cyberattacks highlight the risks of connecting industrial systems to the internet

europe_now.title: Escalation of Conflict in Ukraine
europe_now.summary: Renewed fighting and heavy Russian bombardment have resulted in numerous casualties in Ukraine following the conclusion of a prolonged ceasefire. International diplomatic and regional security measures continue to respond to the deteriorating humanitarian and defense situation.

top_stories.title: Constitutional Crisis in Poland
top_stories.summary: Poland is experiencing a mounting political and institutional crisis centered around its top constitutional court. Several high-ranking diplomats have resigned as the dispute increasingly shapes the national political landscape ahead of upcoming elections.

sources.headline: Crisis over top court shapes Poland’s battle lines before 2027 election

top_stories.title: European Defense and Security Cooperation
top_stories.summary: European forces are preparing to conduct their inaugural Ukraine support exercises within Polish territory. This initiative underscores ongoing regional defense coordination and strategic alignment among European partners.

sources.headline: European force to hold first Ukraine support exercise in Poland
